blocks.text: Abiding faith is living within your system. Faith is a reality. It is not make believe. Faith is the evidence—proof of things not seen. Faith takes the place of what you want before you get it. Faith works, promises are alive. It is a living faith, a forever faith and an eternal faith. Keep your faith in the Lord Jesus. Abiding faith, how sweet the sound!

Trust ye in the Lord forever (Isaiah 26: 4; Proverbs 3: 5 & 6; 2 Thessalonians 3: 5). “…every one that asketh receiveth…” (Matthew 7: 8). All things you ask in my prayer, believing, you shall receive (Matthew 21: 22). If you abide in me and my words abide in you, you shall ask what you will and it shall be done unto you (John 15: 7).
“Abide” is to cling on. Abiding faith is the faith of the prophets, the apostolic way. Hold on to it. It will put you on the right path. It is the faith of the living God.
There is one way to believe, that is to work God’s promises. It doesn’t matter what people believe, what matters is what God tells you to do.
Abiding faith will never let you down. That is the faith that is on the Rock and that Rock is the Lord Jesus Christ.
ARROWS OF FAITH

2 Kings 13: 14-22: Elisha the prophet was fallen sick. God did not take him out immediately, but allowed him to linger a while. Joash, the king of Israel, wept for Elisha and said, “O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel and the horsemen thereof” (v. 14). The prophet told the king to get a bow and arrows. Furthermore, he told the king to open the window and shoot the arrows. The king shot. The prophet said that the arrows were the arrows of God’s deliverance from the Syrians. Then the prophet instructed the king to smite the arrows upon the ground. The king was not prepared. He smote three times and stopped.

The man of God was angry with the king. He said if the king had smitten five or six times, the Syrians would have been entirely consumed. But, because the king stopped at 3, he would only defeat the Syrians three times.

Even at death’s door, Elisha still moved the hand of God. Elisha died and was buried. As the bands of the Moabites were coming during a war, those who were burying a man ran away and threw him into Elisha’s grave out of fear (vs. 20 & 21). The man’s body hit Elisha’s bones and he got up alive. The power of resurrection was resident in the prophet’s bones.

Arrows of faith of believers: Paul’s arrow was steadfastness. David’s arrow was praise and confidence, the arrow that got Goliath. Abraham’s arrow was his power of faith and intercession. What is your arrow of faith?

Our arrow of faith is the word of God. Believe for the impossible to be possible. All things are possible. Don’t you believe little, believe big. If you are going to smite the earth with the arrows, continue and do not stop. Go all out with your faith. Be expecting at any minute for God to do something. The arrows of victory and deliverance are the arrows of faith.
THE CODE BREAKER: THE IMPORTANCE OF FAITH

Most of the bible is in code. To break the code, you must do it with faith. Before the translation, the devil will do everything to discourage and steal faith. The code breaker is faith. Pressure will come upon the people. If you pass the test that is going to come, behold, saith the Lord, “you will go up with me.” The Lord will take care of you until He takes you out of here.

Faith breaks the code into healing, into receiving the promises of God. Real faith is like a hook, it attaches itself. It is good stubbornness for the promises of God. Faith cannot be discouraged. Faith has strong teeth. Faith trusts. It does not give up.

Faith is bolted-down determination to receive what has been promised. If you ride it out, you will be riding with Him (Jesus). Faith will take its ride with Jesus when He comes. Faith has action. It moves steadily like the sun and the moon. It has a duty to perform like the sun and moon. With God’s backing, it cannot fail. True faith is God working in you.

Job said, “Though he slay me, yet will I trust in Him…” (Job 13: 15). In his hard time, Job held on to the Lord like Daniel in the lions’ and the three Hebrew children. Joshua commanded the sun and moon to stand and not move (Joshua 10: 13). David said, “Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil…” Psalm 23: 4). Our Lord Jesus Christ held His faith, no matter what discouragement he saw. The wise men used faith to travel thousands of mile to see and bless Jesus as a baby, but the Pharisees living across the road did nothing because they had no faith.

Hook your faith to the Almighty. Faith is more precious than gold. All things are possible to him that acts on his faith. As time goes on, you are going to need your faith to break the bible code. Better hold on to your faith. Pray to the Lord to give you souls to go with you.

The most important thing with the word of God is your faith. The code breaker will tell you who Jesus is; it will reveal the Godhead and the proper baptism. You will not be caught in the web of the devil and deceit. The elect will have the code of faith. Others will have the code mark of the devil.

You will know things from the Lord as the days go by. Hold on to your faith. The devil cannot take you out. Your faith assures you that you will make it. Use your faith and decode the bible. You will never break gravity without it. Your faith will be so powerful that you cannot be held down when the Lord calls.
The great change is coming. All things are possible. Believe, thou shall see the glory of the God when the trumpet sounds. Believe and thou shall do the greater works.
